headline: 5 killed as lorry ploughs into passengers in Sitakunda
summary: A child and four women were among the dead after a lorry rammed into people waiting by the roadside near the Dhaka-Chattogram highway.
details: Five people, including a child and four women, were killed after a lorry ploughed into them in the Kumira Royal Gate area of Chattogram’s Sitakunda Upazila.
The accident occurred around 2am on Tuesday. The victims were passengers of a Shapla Paribahan bus bound for Kishoreganj, which had stopped by the roadside due to a punctured tyre.
Three people died on the spot, while two others succumbed to their injuries at Chattogram Medical College Hospital.
The victims include 8-year-old Rakib from Netrokona’s Madan area. His parents, Azharul and Fatema, are among the injured currently receiving treatment.
At least four others were injured in the crash. Police have seized the lorry from the scene, but the driver fled immediately after the accident.
Highway Police and firefighters from the Sitakunda Fire Service Station carried out the rescue operation.
caption:
A child and four women killed as a lorry rams into bus passengers waiting by the roadside in Sitakunda.

Five people, including a child and four women, were killed after a lorry ploughed into them in the Kumira Royal Gate area of Chattogram’s Sitakunda Upazila.

The accident occurred around 2am on Tuesday. The victims were passengers of a Shapla Paribahan bus bound for Kishoreganj, which had stopped by the roadside due to a punctured tyre.

Three people died on the spot, while two others succumbed to their injuries at Chattogram Medical College Hospital.

The victims include 8-year-old Rakib from Netrokona’s Madan area. His parents, Azharul and Fatema, are among the injured currently receiving treatment.

At least four others were injured in the crash. Police have seized the lorry from the scene, but the driver fled immediately after the accident.

Highway Police and firefighters from the Sitakunda Fire Service Station carried out the rescue operation.

headline_marked: PM Tarique Rahman and PM Sanae Takaichi [[begin bilateral summit in Tokyo]]
headline: PM Tarique Rahman and PM Sanae Takaichi begin bilateral summit in Tokyo
summary: The high-level talks focus on strengthening trade and investment ties between Bangladesh and Japan.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has met with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in Tokyo to begin bilateral summit talks. The meeting took place on Tuesday at the Kantei, the Japanese prime minister’s office.
The summit is expected to focus primarily on enhancing trade and investment between the two nations. Tarique Rahman was received with a guard of honour and a warm welcome upon his arrival.

The Bangladeshi delegation includes Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury, Finance and Planning Advisor Rashed Al Mahmud Titumir, and State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humaiun Kobir, among others.
Other key officials present include Bangladesh Bank Governor Mostaqur Rahman and Foreign Secretary Asad Alam Siam. They were joined by the Japanese foreign minister and other senior officials.
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman arrived in Tokyo on Monday via a Biman Bangladesh Airlines flight. He is currently on a four-day state visit to Japan, accompanied by Zubaida Rahman.
caption:
Bangladesh and Japan kick off high-level summit talks in Tokyo to boost trade and investment.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has met with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in Tokyo to begin bilateral summit talks. The meeting took place on Tuesday at the Kantei, the Japanese prime minister’s office.

The summit is expected to focus primarily on enhancing trade and investment between the two nations. Tarique Rahman was received with a guard of honour and a warm welcome upon his arrival.

The Bangladeshi delegation includes Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury, Finance and Planning Advisor Rashed Al Mahmud Titumir, and State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humaiun Kobir, among others.

Other key officials present include Bangladesh Bank Governor Mostaqur Rahman and Foreign Secretary Asad Alam Siam. They were joined by the Japanese foreign minister and other senior officials.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman arrived in Tokyo on Monday via a Biman Bangladesh Airlines flight. He is currently on a four-day state visit to Japan, accompanied by Zubaida Rahman.
